en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a broad open yard in front of several connected barracks‑like buildings with large windows and chimneys. Sparse small trees and bushes stand in the foreground. The architecture is simple and functional, suggesting military or institutional use. Handwritten numbers mark a few buildings. Along the bottom is printed Swedish text identifying the place.
